assumptions.dynamics: Phase-folded synthetic train-aggregate loss is frozen across cycles as a separate hypothesis even if the sampled map depends on temperature; exact exponential cooling on constant-power segments, with separate continuous and whole-lump prelaunch-suppressed cooling hypotheses
assumptions.limits: No measured force/loss/cooling; no station occupancy, tail clearance, 900 m winding or physical qualification. Headways other than 120 s are sensitivity inputs, not demonstrated service.
assumptions.numerical: Force/power loss cross-checked against forward-Euler temperature inversion, with explicit signed roundoff budget; exponential repeated-duty model is a separate assumption
assumptions.overlap: Sum all phase-overlapping pulses; no fixed-bank, converter, feeder or receiving allocation
assumptions.prelaunch: Each 1 s adiabatic prelaunch loss is added once at departure, not as an extra second; timing inside that second is unresolved

model_domain.scope: Bounded synthetic sampled temperature and declared maximum only; no thermal qualification

prelaunch_cooling_suppressed.cooling_hypothesis: suppressed for the entire aggregate during the prelaunch interval

model_domain.scope: Bounded synthetic sampled temperature and declared maximum only; no thermal qualification

prelaunch.basis: Constant-current stationary pre-excitation for the declared duration; included as an energy/initial-temperature assumption, not a measured startup sequence.

reconstruction.scope: Electrical input minus midpoint mechanical power, independently cross-checked against forward-Euler temperatures; no motor loss measurement

temperature_grid.scope: Exact equality of declared grid-node outputs; no temperature-dependent material validation
